CREATE TABLE orders (
  id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  order_amount DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  order_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT fk_orders_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id)
);

metadata.description: 订单表，记录所有电商交易流水。包含订单ID、客户ID、订单金额、订单状态、创建和更新时间等字段。

document:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(20),
  address TEXT,
  customer_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'individual',
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

metadata.description: 客户表，存储所有客户的基本信息。支持个人客户和企业客户两种类型。

document:
CREATE TABLE products (
  id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  product_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  category_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  stock_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  description TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT fk_products_category FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
);

metadata.description: 商品表，记录所有可销售的商品信息。包含商品名称、分类、价格、库存等字段。

document:
CREATE TABLE categories (
  id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  category_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

metadata.description: 商品分类表，记录商品所属的分类信息。

document:
CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  product_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  price DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  subtotal DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT fk_order_items_order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_order_items_product FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
);

metadata.description: 订单明细表，记录每个订单中的商品明细。包含订单ID、商品ID、数量、单价、小计等字段。
